ExpectationsRequest.description:
mununu#537 — the caller's claims about a run's verdicts.

There is deliberately **no** "tolerate undecided" field. Naming a property `unknown` in `named` is the sound version of that wish: it pins the abstention as a claim that fails when the property becomes decidable, instead of excusing it. See [`crate::adapter::slang::expectations`] for the incident that settled this.

all_hold.description: Every property must hold, with nothing unsupported, unknown or skipped.

count.description: The property count must be exactly this — catches a binding that stopped binding, whose smaller all-green set otherwise reads as a clean pass.

named.description: `name -> verdict` (`"holds"` | `"violated"` | `"unknown"` | `"skipped"`). Unnamed properties are ignored, except that an unnamed VIOLATED is still a failure.

violated.description: These must be VIOLATED **and every other property must hold**.

SvFrontendName.description: The RTL front end of a lift: `auto` (the environment's default), `verilog` (yosys `read_verilog`), `slang` (the yosys-slang plugin) or `sv2v` (sv2v first, then the `auto` order with its slang fallback). The CLI's `--frontend` takes the same four values.

SvLiftRequest.description: The SV design and how to lift it, shared by every `sv` route: the API peer of the CLI's lift flags (`SV_FILE` / `--source`, `--top`, `--frontend`, `--param`, `--lift-override`, `--cutpoint`, `--merge-clock-domains`). Unknown keys are refused.

cutpoints.description: Control-slice cut points: each named net becomes a free input (an over-approximation).

lift_overrides.description: Lift-only replacements of a source by file name (an assertion-macro shim, a synthesis variant). `sv verify-auto` still extracts its SVA from the original sources.

merge_clock_domains.description: Lift a multi-clock design onto the model's one implicit clock instead of refusing it. An UNDER-approximation: the domains only ever tick together, so a HOLDS does not transfer.

source_name.description: The primary source's file name, which `lift_overrides` match (default `<top>.sv`, or `top.sv` without a `top`).

TemplateRef.description:
A concrete template reference (template ID + bound arguments).

Used in `.espec.json`, `.mununu.json`, XState `__mununu`, CLI, and API requests as an alternative to a raw formula string.

description: XL.6b — automated SVA verification endpoint (`POST /api/v1/sv/verify-auto`). Mirrors the CLI `mununu sv verify-auto`: extract the design's SVA, lift, and verify each property against the model with no sidecar. slang parses SV directly, but the verify lift uses sv2v + Yosys, so `top` / `use_sv2v` apply.

antecedent_propagate.description: mununu#629 — antecedent constant propagation on the exact-symbolic engine (default `true`): a same-cycle implication `sig == K |-> C` has `K` propagated through `C`'s cone (a read mux folds to the selected arm), so a property about one field of a wide packed record decides instead of skipping on the bit cap. `false` leaves the formula as lifted (the differential-oracle / debug knob; the CLI's `--no-antecedent-propagate`, `MUNUNU_NO_ANTECEDENT_PROPAGATE=1`).

assumes.description: How SVA `assume` statements are treated: `"precondition"` (default — the guarantees are checked on the traces along which every applied assumption has held), `"check"` (each assumption is checked like an assertion and constrains nothing) or `"ignore"`. Mirrors the CLI's `--assumes`. Any other value is a 400.

auto_stub_flops.description: Auto-inject behavioral stubs for cut flop primitives (e.g. OpenTitan's `prim_sparse_fsm_flop`) so the register survives the lift (default `true`). Set `false` to leave cut flops reported as black-boxed.

counter_bounds.description: H.H — counter upper bounds: seed a `signal <= value` cube-partition to refine a counter-monotonicity property (`cnt_q >= $past(cnt_q)`) whose ⊥ is caused by the abstract 32-bit wraparound. Each entry `"signal<=value"` (the `"signal=value"` spelling is also accepted, same meaning). Sound (a partition, not an assumption — the must-edges verify it); requires `must_edge_inference` on. Bounds are also auto-derived from `config_values`; a manual entry here overrides the inferred one. Surfaced as a `counter-bound` note. Default empty.

emit_testbench.description: Return a Verilator replay testbench with every counterexample (`--emit-testbench`).

engine.description: Engine selector, mirroring the CLI `--engine`: `"explicit"`, `"symbolic"`, `"exact-symbolic"`, `"portfolio-sequential"`, `"portfolio-parallel"`. **Unspecified ⇒ the default `"portfolio-sequential"`** (2026-07-06): run exact → symbolic → explicit, stopping when every property is decided — the most precise sound choice, no slower than the former `explicit` default on designs `explicit` already decided. Resolved by `verify_auto::engine_selection`.

expectations.description:
mununu#537 — assert that this run produces the verdicts the caller claims. Omitted ⇒ no claim, and the response carries no `expectations` block.

The HTTP peer of the CLI's `--expect-all-hold` / `--expect-count` / `--expect-violated` / `--expect`. A gate driving mununu over HTTP wants the same three assertions a gate driving it on the command line does.

fault_model.description: Fault-injection posture from the design's countermeasures: `"sec-cm"` / `"sec-cm:k"` (`"sec-cm:0"` selects and runs the antecedent-vacuity check only). Alternative to `faults`; both is a 400. Mirrors the CLI `--fault-model`.

fault_warmup.description: Cycles before the first injection may fire (default 10). Mirrors `--fault-warmup`.

faults.description: Fault-injection posture: registers the adversary may overwrite (`"REG"` / `"REG:k"`, one global budget, default 1; `"REG:unbounded"`). Mirrors the CLI `--fault`. Default empty.

gate_reset.description: Reset-gating: drop recognized `disable iff (reset)` guards and pin the reset input inactive at the model level (default `true`). Set `false` to keep the guard and leave the reset free.

input_state.description: mununu#656 — inputs in the state on the exact-symbolic engine (default `true`): a property that reads a primary input, or a signal combinationally driven by one, is decided over the registers with that input sampled in the same cycle. `false` restores the engine's refusal of such atoms (the differential-oracle knob; the CLI's `--no-input-state`, `MUNUNU_NO_INPUT_STATE=1`).

lift.description: The SV design and how to lift it (the CLI's shared lift flags).

localize.description: Name, for every violated row, the registers whose next-state function, freed at some cycles with the counterexample's inputs fixed, would let the property survive the trace — repair candidates (`trace.repair_candidates` / `trace.localization`; 2026-10-30). One native-BMC query per register in the property's cone, so off by default.

must_edge_inference.description: Must-edge inference per property. Default (absent or `"auto"`, mununu#663): a Liveness/Mixed-class formula — a μ under a ν, `AG EF` / `AG AF` — runs its cube member with `"smt-per-target-standard"` (its 3-valued `◇` turns true only through must edges; may-only is structurally ⊥ there), the rest may-only. `"off"` switches that resolution off; `"smt-per-target"`, `"smt-per-target-standard"`, `"smt-hyper-must"` apply to every property.

pins.description: H.J.b — config concretization: pin wide config inputs to constants so comparisons against them become decidable. Each entry `"signal=value"` (e.g. `"cfg_detect_timer_i=7"`). The verdicts are then SCOPED to these values (surfaced as a `config-concretization` note). Default empty.

predicate.description: Abstraction-predicate hints, mirroring the CLI `--predicate` and the in-source `// @mununu_predicate <expr>` annotation (all three are merged). Each entry is a predicate expression (`"reg == value"`, `"reg == reg"`, `"reg >= K"`) seeded as a cube dimension for EVERY property, even when absent from the property formula. Sound by monotonicity — a hint only refines the cube (a ⊥ can become definite; a definite verdict never flips; an unclassifiable hint is dropped). Default empty.

replay.description: Build and run each replay testbench under Verilator on the server (`make`, then `make trace`) and report the result on the row (`trace.replay.result`: match / mismatch / unavailable with its reason); needs `emit_testbench` (2026-10-29).

rescue.description: The ⊥ escalations (default `true`, the CLI's `--no-rescue` sets `false`): a property the cube leaves ⊥ is retried by the lane for its shape — a reducible safety invariant by the reachability portfolio, a box-AF response by liveness-to-safety plus the portfolio, an `AG EF (REG == VALUE)` recoverability by the cube with `smt-hyper-must`. `false` reports the cube's ⊥ unchanged.

tb_clock.description: The clock port the testbench toggles (default: the first of `clk`, `clk_i`, `clock`, `i_clk`, `aclk`, `clk_sys` the source declares).

templates.description: Property templates to check besides the design's assertions, each `{template, args}` (`{"template": "rtl_response", "args": {"TRIGGER": "trip == 1", "RESPONSE": "state_q == SCRAM"}}`), instantiated against the server's catalog. Each becomes a row labelled `tmpl.<instance>`. Default empty. The same instance can be written in the source as `// @mununu_template(<name>) rtl_response TRIGGER="trip == 1" RESPONSE="state_q == SCRAM"` (2026-10-30), which needs no request field.
